thesis: The page is the sanding pass: each section is one grit, and the signature is the grit number that gets finer as you scroll from bare wood to finish coat.

signature.name: Grit Sequence Rail
signature.summary: A horizontal rail carries the grit number (36 · 60 · 100 · STAIN · COAT 1 · 2 · 3) at each section top; noise texture grain matches the grit; rail draws left-to-right on scroll via --sw-p clip-path wipe.

palette.family: Raw Maple + Walnut Ink + Finish Amber

layoutMoves: pinned crossfade story with grit counter
